problem.concept: When attempting to perform Machine Translation (MT), these variations have a significant effect on how the system should perform translation, but this is not captured well by standard one-size-fits-all models

review_notes: Checked user-specific softmax-bias and factored alternatives, one-size-fits-all limitation and the three-language TED improvement/trait finding; no unsupported language names or further dataset version to add.

problem.concept: origin of these regularities has remained opaque

task.concept: analyze and make explicit the model properties needed for such regularities to emerge in word vectors

method.concept: training only on the nonzero elements in a word-word cooccurrence matrix

contribution.concept: Glove

model efficiently leverages statistical information by training only on the nonzero elements in a word-word cooccurrence matrix, rather than on the entire sparse matrix or on individual context windows in a large corpus
model produces a vector space with meaningful substructure, as evidenced by its performance of 75% on a recent word analogy task
It also outperforms related models on similarity tasks and named entity recognition

review_notes: Recovered the named Glove artifact and operational model from the title, replacing the generic new-model artifact. Preserved nonzero cooccurrence training, 75% analogy performance and similarity/NER comparisons.

problem.concept: labelling process is based on a laborious task where annotators manually inspect each utterance and assign the corresponding label

method.concept: unsupervised learning method in the embedding space

contribution.concept: Active Annotation (AA)
lexicons that can be open categories and adapted over time

problem.concept: Most neural machine translation (NMT) models operate on source and target sentences, treating them as sequences of words and neglecting their syntactic structure

method.concept: attention heads that can attend to the dependency parent of each token

contribution.concept: Parent-Scaled Self-Attention
proposed model is simple yet effective, requiring no additional parameter and improving the translation quality of the Transformer model especially for long sentences and low-resource scenarios

review_notes: Restored three distinct translation-language settings and dataset tracks/years from A6. Preserved dependency-parent attention, no-extra-parameter constraint, long-sentence and low-resource qualifications.

problem.concept: such representations are effective and may capture the morphological regularities of words, they have not been systematically compared, and it is not understood how they interact with different morphological typologies

problem.concept: annotation projection for parser induction across languages showed only limited success and often required substantial language-specific post-processing to fix inconsistencies and to lift the performance onto a useful level

recently developed cross-lingually harmonized annotation schemes remove this obstacle and restore the abilities of syntactic annotation projection
results outperform the simple direct transfer approach by a large margin and also pave the road to cross-lingual parsing without gold POS labels

review_notes: Recovered lexicalized parsers used in the comparison and removed projection strategies duplicating annotation projection. Preserved old limited-success motivation and new evaluation-scheme and no-gold-POS findings.
